findings.title: Supply the missing guarded PAUSE transition before requiring positive RESUME
findings.description: The required continue_resume_current_dc oracle demands a valid ResumeSession that appends a new immutable binding and forbids raw PAUSE/state seeding. At the protected base and reviewed head, ResumeSession requires an existing PAUSED session with a START binding (transactions.py:3038), while StartSession, ResumeSession and ContinueSession can write S44 only with lifecycle IN_PROGRESS (transactions.py:1725-1736). ProtocolExecutionService exposes publish/commit/start only; no source service writes PAUSED. The sole existing test setup for PAUSED is a raw administrative UPDATE (test_transaction_interfaces.py:5905), explicitly forbidden by this packet. Neither KL075/KL076 nor KL077 declares an authenticated guarded pause owner or prerequisite. A guard-only negative setup cannot satisfy the separately required valid RESUME oracle. Consequently this supposedly enforceable task cannot complete without hidden owner expansion or prohibited output seeding.

Refresh exact packet/backlog/traceability/validator projections and rerun governance checks on a new tested revision before fresh review.
